# Overview

Plaque-derived endothelial cells (ECs) from five donors were stimulated for 144 h
with PF4 (5 ng/mL), TGF-β1 (10 ng/mL) or left unstimulated (control), followed
by bulk RNA-seq (CEL-Seq2 adapted protocol). The PF4- and TGF-β-responsive gene
sets are then projected onto the plaque snRNA-seq data (notebook 01) and the
spatial data (notebook 04).

| Step | Section | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Count filtering, DESeq2 object, VST, PCA | 1-2 | Fig. 4B |
| Differential expression (donor-adjusted DESeq2) | 3 | Fig. 4C, 4F, Tables S11-S12 |
| Enrichment (Enrichr) | 4 | Fig. 4D-E, 4G-H, Table S13 |
| PF4/TGF-β module scores in plaque snRNA-seq | 5 | Fig. 5A-D |
| Overlap PF4-induced genes vs accelerated-plaque EC genes | 6 | Fig. 5E-F |

Sample columns of the count matrix are named `<Condition>_<Timepoint>_<Donor>.sam.counts`.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)        # v1.44.0
  library(SummarizedExperiment)

  library(Seurat)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(EnhancedVolcano)
  library(enrichR)
  library(VennDiagram)
  library(openxlsx)
})
source("R/helper_functions.R")

set.seed(1234)
dir.create(params$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
fig_dir <- file.path(params$out_dir, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(params$out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE); dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 1. Read counts and build the DESeq2 object

```{r read-counts}
counts <- read.delim(file.path(params$data_dir, params$counts_file), header = TRUE)
rownames(counts) <- counts[, 1]
counts <- as.matrix(counts[, -1])

sample_info <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(colnames(counts), split = "_"))
coldata <- data.frame(Sample_name = colnames(counts),
                      Condition   = sample_info[, 1],
                      Timepoint   = sample_info[, 2],
                      Donor       = paste0("AE", gsub(".sam.counts", "", sample_info[, 3], fixed = TRUE)))
donors <- read.csv(file.path(params$data_dir, params$donor_file))
coldata$Sex <- donors$Sex[match(coldata$Donor, donors$Donor)]
coldata$Donor <- factor(coldata$Donor)
table(coldata$Condition, coldata$Timepoint)

# Remove genes with a total count <= 30 across all samples
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 30, ]
dim(counts)

RNA_EC <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts), colData = coldata)

# Ensembl -> gene symbol (Ensembl ID kept when no symbol is available)
symbols <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = rownames(RNA_EC), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
symbols[is.na(symbols)] <- rownames(RNA_EC)[is.na(symbols)]
```

# 2. Principal component analysis (Fig. 4B)

Variance-stabilised counts (blind VST) of the T144 control, PF4 and TGF-β
samples; donor effects removed with `limma::removeBatchEffect` for visualisation.

```{r fig4b, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
dds_all <- DESeqDataSet(RNA_EC, design = ~ Donor + Condition)
vsd <- vst(dds_all, blind = TRUE)

vsd_sub <- vsd[, vsd$Timepoint == "T144" & vsd$Condition %in% c("Control", "TGF", "PF4")]
mat_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(assay(vsd_sub), batch = vsd_sub$Donor)
pca <- prcomp(t(mat_corrected), scale. = FALSE)
percentVar <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)
pca_df <- data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2], Condition = vsd_sub$Condition, Donor = vsd_sub$Donor)

p4b <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Condition, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.25, level = 0.95) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_condition) + scale_fill_manual(values = col_condition) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
save_fig(p4b, "Fig4B_PCA.png", 22, 14, fig_dir)
p4b
```

# 3. Differential expression at T144 (Tables S11-S12)

Each comparison is fitted on the two conditions involved with a donor-adjusted
design (`~ Donor + Condition`). DEGs: FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 0.25.

```{r deseq2}
run_deseq <- function(treatment, reference) {
  se <- RNA_EC[, RNA_EC$Timepoint == "T144" & RNA_EC$Condition %in% c(treatment, reference)]
  se$Donor <- droplevels(se$Donor)
  dds <- DESeq(DESeqDataSet(se, design = ~ Donor + Condition))
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Condition", treatment, reference))
  res$symbols <- symbols[rownames(res)]
  res[order(res$padj), ]
}

res_list <- list(
  PF4_vs_Control = run_deseq("PF4", "Control"),
  TGF_vs_Control = run_deseq("TGF", "Control"),
  PF4_vs_TGF     = run_deseq("PF4", "TGF"))
saveRDS(res_list, file.path(params$out_dir, "DESeq2_results_T144.rds"))

# Direction labels per comparison (positive log2FC = first condition)
direction_labels <- list(PF4_vs_Control = c(up = "PF4_up", down = "Control_up"),
                         TGF_vs_Control = c(up = "TGF_up", down = "Control_up"),
                         PF4_vs_TGF     = c(up = "PF4_up", down = "TGF_up"))

make_deg_table <- function(res, comparison) {
  df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(symbols)) %>%
    distinct(symbols, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Gene = symbols)
  bind_rows(
    df %>% filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange >  0.25) %>%
      mutate(Comparison = comparison, Direction = direction_labels[[comparison]][["up"]]),
    df %>% filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange < -0.25) %>%
      mutate(Comparison = comparison, Direction = direction_labels[[comparison]][["down"]])) %>%
    dplyr::select(Comparison, Direction, Gene, everything())
}

DEG_all <- bind_rows(lapply(names(res_list), function(n) make_deg_table(res_list[[n]], n)))
summary_deg <- DEG_all %>% count(Comparison, Direction, name = "Number_of_DEGs")
summary_deg
```

## Responsive gene sets used downstream

```{r gene-sets}
sig_genes <- function(res, direction = c("up", "down"), lfc = 0.25) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  keep <- df$padj < 0.05 & (if (direction == "up") df$log2FoldChange > lfc else df$log2FoldChange < -lfc)
  unique(trimws(na.omit(df$symbols[keep])))
}

gene_sets <- list(
  PF4_up_vs_control       = sig_genes(res_list$PF4_vs_Control, "up"),    # spatial PF4 score (notebook 04)
  TGF_up_vs_control       = sig_genes(res_list$TGF_vs_Control, "up"),
  PF4_specific_vs_TGF     = sig_genes(res_list$PF4_vs_TGF, "up"),        # PF4 module (Fig. 5A-B)
  TGF_specific_vs_PF4     = sig_genes(res_list$PF4_vs_TGF, "down"))      # TGF-β module (Fig. 5C-D, notebook 04)
lengths(gene_sets)
saveRDS(gene_sets, file.path(params$out_dir, "responsive_gene_sets.rds"))
```

## Fig. 4C and 4F - volcano plots

```{r fig4-volcano, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
volcano_bulk <- function(res, select_lab, down_col, ylim) {
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  plot_volcano(df, x = "log2FoldChange", y = "padj", lab = df$symbols, select_lab = select_lab,
               up_col = col_condition[["PF4"]], down_col = down_col, xlim = c(-4, 4), ylim = ylim,
               ylab = bquote(-Log[10]~italic(adj.P)), label_size = 4, point_size = 2.5)
}

p4c <- volcano_bulk(res_list$PF4_vs_Control,
                    c("NPPB", "CALD1", "COL4A1", "COL1A2", "IGFBP3", "ELN", "IL1RL1", "HMGA1", "CCNB2", "MYBL2", "TRBC2"),
                    down_col = col_condition[["Control"]], ylim = c(0, 15))
p4f <- volcano_bulk(res_list$PF4_vs_TGF,
                    c("NQO1", "NDRG4", "ALDH1A3", "BMP4", "CD34", "FBN1", "KCNMB1", "SERPINE2", "ACTA2"),
                    down_col = col_condition[["TGF"]], ylim = c(0, 30))
save_fig(p4c, "Fig4C_volcano_PF4_vs_control.png", 16, 18, fig_dir)
save_fig(p4f, "Fig4F_volcano_PF4_vs_TGF.png", 16, 18, fig_dir)
cowplot::plot_grid(p4c, p4f)
```

# 4. Enrichment of PF4-induced genes (Fig. 4D-E, 4G-H, Table S13)

DEGs (FDR < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.25) of each direction were tested with Enrichr
(gene sets with >= 5 genes), with all genes tested in the comparison as
background.

```{r enrichment}
init_enrichr()
db_labels <- c(GO_Molecular_Function_2025 = "GO_Molecular_Function", GO_Cellular_Component_2025 = "GO_Cellular_Component",
               GO_Biological_Process_2025 = "GO_Biological_Process", Reactome_Pathways_2024 = "Reactome",
               KEGG_2021_Human = "KEGG", MSigDB_Hallmark_2020 = "Hallmark")

enrich_bulk <- list()
enrichment_all <- list()
for (cmp in names(res_list)) {
  for (d in c("up", "down")) {
    direction <- direction_labels[[cmp]][[d]]
    genes <- DEG_all %>% filter(Comparison == cmp, Direction == direction) %>% pull(Gene)
    if (length(genes) < 5) next
    res <- run_enrichr(genes, background = res_list[[cmp]]$symbols)
    enrich_bulk[[paste0(cmp, ifelse(d == "up", "_Up", "_Down"))]] <- res
    enrichment_all[[paste(cmp, direction)]] <- bind_rows(lapply(names(db_labels), function(db) {
      df <- as.data.frame(res[[db]])
      if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
      df %>% filter(P.value < 0.05) %>%
        mutate(Comparison = cmp, Direction = direction, Database = db_labels[[db]]) %>%
        dplyr::select(Comparison, Direction, Database, everything())
    }))
  }
}
enrichment_all <- bind_rows(enrichment_all)
saveRDS(enrich_bulk, file.path(params$out_dir, "enrichr_EC_stimulation.rds"))

# Tables S11-S13: DEGs and enrichment of the EC stimulation experiment
summary_enrichment <- enrichment_all %>% count(Comparison, Direction, Database, name = "Number_of_Enriched_Terms")
wb <- createWorkbook()
sheets <- list(Summary_DEGs = summary_deg, Summary_Enrichment = summary_enrichment,
               DEGs = DEG_all, Enrichment = enrichment_all)
for (s in names(sheets)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, s)
  writeData(wb, s, sheets[[s]])
  addStyle(wb, s, createStyle(textDecoration = "bold"), rows = 1, cols = 1:30, gridExpand = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb, s, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, s, cols = 1:30, widths = "auto")
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(tab_dir, "TablesS11-S13_EC_PF4_TGF_DEG_Enrichment.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

# 5. PF4- and TGF-β-responsive module scores in plaque snRNA-seq (Fig. 5A-D)

Module scores (`Seurat::AddModuleScore`) for the genes specifically induced by
PF4 relative to TGF-β (PF4 vs TGF-β, FDR < 0.05, log2FC > 0.25) and by TGF-β
relative to PF4 (log2FC < -0.25). ECs from accelerated and decelerated plaques
were compared with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test.

```{r load-snrna}
merged_plaque <- readRDS(file.path(params$snrna_dir, "seurat_8plaques_snRNAseq_annotated.rds"))
deg_sn <- readRDS(file.path(params$snrna_dir, "DEG_MAST_cell_groups.rds"))

merged_plaque <- AddModuleScore(merged_plaque, features = list(gene_sets$PF4_specific_vs_TGF), name = "PF4_module")
merged_plaque <- AddModuleScore(merged_plaque, features = list(gene_sets$TGF_specific_vs_PF4), name = "TGF_module")
```

```{r fig5a-d, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
module_umap <- function(feature, legend_title) {
  FeaturePlot(merged_plaque, features = feature, reduction = "umap.harmony", pt.size = 1.3, order = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#E8DDF2", "#9B59B6", "#4A176A"), name = legend_title) +
    ggtitle(NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20), legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
          legend.key.height = unit(2, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"))
}

module_box <- function(feature, ylab) {
  df <- FetchData(subset(merged_plaque, subset = Cell_Group == "ECs"), vars = c(feature, "EAA.dich")) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(paste(EAA.dich, "ECs"), levels = c("Accelerated ECs", "Decelerated ECs")))
  ggboxplot(df, x = "Group", y = feature, fill = "Group", add = "jitter", width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Accelerated ECs" = "#7E4D9E", "Decelerated ECs" = "#66C2A5")) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", size = 7) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

p5a <- module_umap("PF4_module1", "PF4-specific\nmodule score")
p5b <- module_box("PF4_module1", "Module Score PF4 genes")
p5c <- module_umap("TGF_module1", "TGF-specific\nmodule score")
p5d <- module_box("TGF_module1", "Module Score TGF genes")

save_fig(p5a, "Fig5A_UMAP_PF4_module.png", 8, 6, fig_dir, units = "in")
save_fig(p5b, "Fig5B_box_PF4_module_ECs.png", 8, 6, fig_dir, units = "in")
save_fig(p5c, "Fig5C_UMAP_TGF_module.png", 8, 6, fig_dir, units = "in")
save_fig(p5d, "Fig5D_box_TGF_module_ECs.png", 8, 6, fig_dir, units = "in")
cowplot::plot_grid(p5a, p5b, p5c, p5d, ncol = 2)
```

# 6. Overlap of PF4-induced genes with genes upregulated in accelerated-plaque ECs (Fig. 5E-F)

PF4-induced genes (PF4 vs control, FDR < 0.05, log2FC > 0) were intersected
with genes upregulated in ECs from accelerated plaques (snRNA-seq MAST,
adjusted P < `r params$sn_padj_overlap`, log2FC > 0). Enrichment of the overlap was assessed with a
one-sided Fisher's exact test, using all genes tested in the snRNA-seq EC
comparison (plus both gene sets) as universe.

```{r overlap}
pf4_up_all <- sig_genes(res_list$PF4_vs_Control, "up", lfc = 0)
ec_acc_up  <- rownames(deg_sn$ECs)[deg_sn$ECs$p_val_adj < params$sn_padj_overlap & deg_sn$ECs$avg_log2FC > 0]

ov <- overlap_fisher(pf4_up_all, ec_acc_up, universe = rownames(deg_sn$ECs))
ov$table
ov$test$p.value
overlap_table <- deg_sn$ECs[ov$overlap, ] %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  left_join(as.data.frame(res_list$PF4_vs_Control) %>%
              dplyr::select(gene = symbols, bulk_log2FC_PF4 = log2FoldChange, bulk_padj_PF4 = padj),
            by = "gene")
write.xlsx(overlap_table, file.path(tab_dir, "Overlap_PF4_bulk_vs_ECs_accelerated.xlsx"))
overlap_table
```

```{r fig5e, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
venn <- venn.diagram(x = list(PF4_up = pf4_up_all, ECs_Accelerated = ec_acc_up),
                     category.names = c("", ""), filename = NULL,
                     fill = c("#4A176A", "#C59AD8"), alpha = 0.5, cex = 6, fontface = "bold",
                     fontfamily = "sans", cat.fontfamily = "sans", bg = "white")
png(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig5E_venn_PF4_ECs_accelerated.png"), width = 25, height = 20, units = "cm", res = 300)
grid::grid.draw(venn); dev.off()
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(venn)
```
